svg.title: Fraud, risk and compliance in three of IBM’s figures
svg.desc: Three of IBM's figures: Safer Payments 6.10 cuts instance restore time by up to 50% in IBM benchmarks; IBM Trusteer's intelligence network spans millions of devices in 190 countries; IBM lists nine OpenPages modules. Each figure is IBM's, from its Safer Payments, Trusteer and OpenPages pages. The 50% is from IBM benchmarks; IBM states no further conditions.
